title: UFC Data: scorecards, round statistics, and betting odds, 2013 to 2026
description:
Fight-level and judge-round data for UFC fights from 2013-02-16 through 2026-10-10, linking judges' round-by-round scorecards to round statistics, betting odds, official rankings at fight time, and fighter attributes.

See README.md and METHODS.md for what is included, how it was built, and known limitations.

This project is independent. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the UFC. UFC and related marks belong to their owners.
